codeFindings.detail: BC pagination on this site is HTML, NOT API. nordicmarksman's DB profile has NO apiAlternative and NO apiConfig.klevuApiKey, so generic-retail.fetchCatalogPage() returns null at the final guard, the catalog crawler's API loop breaks (catalog-crawler.ts:296-299), and the walk falls through to the HTML path (extractCatalogProducts + getNextPageUrl). Next page is taken from the page's own a[rel=next]/.pagination-item--next a (getNextPageUrl, generic-retail.ts:1331-1355), which is /categories.php?sort=newest&page=N. buildPaginatedUrl is not used for the next link here; the site's own link is followed.

codeFindings.theme: B / H (count method = HTML grid; perPage NOT applied to HTML URL)
codeFindings.detail: perPage:2500 is INERT for the HTML walk. _getSiteSpecificUrls returns profile.catalogUrls verbatim (/categories.php). getCatalogUrls/getNewArrivalsUrls append sortParam (?sort=newest) but NEVER append ?limit=. perPage is passed only to fetchCatalogPage() (the API adapters), which returns null here. Repo-wide grep: the only limit= injections are Shopify products.json (shopify.ts:250) and the Shopify count-probe (product-count-probe.ts:369) - neither applies to BC. Live proof: runtime watermark URL /categories.php?sort=newest returns 20 cards and rel=next is /categories.php?sort=newest&page=2 (no limit). NET: full catalog refresh walks ~239 pages of 20 (4781/20), not 2 pages of 2500. Coverage is correct; the 2500 value just mis-documents request volume. Recommend the skill flag perPage as 'API-only; inert on HTML-walk BC/Magento sites' OR add ?limit injection to the HTML catalog URL builder (latter = behavior change, out of R2 scope).

For paginationPattern.type='query' template='page' (this site), buildPaginatedUrl uses the new URL() branch and sets ?page=N. No leading-slash bug applies (that bug is the type='path' branch only, lines 122-126). nordicmarksman's query pattern is safe. Note buildPaginatedUrl is a backup; the live walk prefers getNextPageUrl's parsed rel=next link.

case 'sitemap-index' iterates m.urls, handles relative+absolute, sums <loc>. DB's relative-path urls[] shape is runtime-compatible. Only fires when expectedProductCount absent (present here = 4761). Documentation-correct.

Above the 95% COVERAGE_THRESHOLD. Operator may add leaf-subcat URLs for the last ~1.2% if desired (per Full Coverage rule), but /categories.php single-URL is the correct primary spine.
coverageProof.recommendedAgainst: R1's 10-category nav spine. B4R1 walked the 12-parent spine and reached only 4485 unique (94.6%) because BC Stencil parent categories do NOT recurse into subcategories; the single /categories.php global grid reaches more (98.8%) with 1 URL and 2 fetches at limit=2500 (or ~239 fetches at the runtime default 20/page).
